products.name: Contact Lens Order Desk
products.product: A focused optometry contact lens order tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent optometry practices and optical dispensaries
products.problem: Prescription confirmation, trial outcome, brand parameters, payment, supplier status, patient notice, and pickup are tracked across the EHR, distributor, and phone log.
products.valueProposition: Turns optometry contact lens order tracking into a visible operating queue so every contact-lens order moves from authorized specification to received, notified, and collected or closed.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets optometry contact lens order tracking software, optometry contact lens order tracking tracker, optometry contact lens order tracking template, and optometry contact lens order tracking checklist searches.

products.name: Optometry Recall Outreach
products.product: A focused optometry patient recall outreach workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.

products.problem: Recall eligibility, contact preferences, failed attempts, booked appointments, transfer status, and stop reasons are inconsistent across outreach lists.
products.valueProposition: Turns optometry patient recall outreach into a visible operating queue so every due recall receives policy-aligned outreach and ends in a booking, future date, transfer, or documented stop reason.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
